copy.headline: Arlington police officer shoots dog while responding to commercial alarm
copy.caption:
An Arlington police officer is on administrative leave after shooting a dog that charged at him during an alarm call. Arlington police officers responded to a commercial alarm at a business along West Pioneer Parkway on Tuesday.

While officers checked the outside of the business, a dog came out from behind the building and charged toward one of the officers, according to police. The officer did not suffer any injuries.

story.title: Arlington police officer shoots dog while responding to commercial alarm
story.summary: An Arlington police officer is on administrative leave after shooting a dog that charged at him during an alarm call. ARLINGTON, Texas - An Arlington police officer is on administrative leave after shooting a dog that charged at him during an alarm call. Arlington police officers responded to a commercial alarm at a business along West Pioneer Parkway on Tuesday. While officers checked the outside of the business, a dog came out from behind the building and charged toward one of the officers, according to police. The officer did not suffer any injuries. The dog was taken to a veterinarian for treatment, police say. Arlington police have not shared the dog's current condition or the identity of the officer involved.
